brief: Teste l'espace client Customer Self-Service : se connecter, consulter ses contrats et demander un devis.

classes.reason: The accepted sheet is inconsistent with the requested scenario: the title and intent require signing in and creating a new home-insurance quote, but the sheet's only steps merely inspect an already-submitted request. Its first expectation assumes that request exists immediately after opening /, while the local application instead shows the login landing page. No planned steps create the quote; adding sign-in and quote-wizard steps would depart from the fixed sheet. Thus this test cannot execute the scenario as specified.

runs.failedStep: 1. Open Customer Self-Service at its current policies page, which already contains the submitted quote from exploration
